title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Bar Chart – Library Visits and Computer Use
prompt:
The bar chart below shows the average number of visits to a public library and the average number of hours spent using library computers per person per year in five different age groups in a European country between 2018 and 2022.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先仔细阅读图表标题、横轴与纵轴单位，以及图例。写作时，先概括总体趋势，再选取2–3个最显著的对比特征进行描述，并引用具体数据支持。注意不要加入个人观点或原因分析。建议用时20分钟，写完后检查是否达到150词。
